description: This file contains functions and procedures for configuring DHCP protocol behavior in a network setup, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown of DHCP client configurations, as well as helper functions for generating DHCP options and client IDs.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCP protocol configuration parameters with default values and argument parsing.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Appends DHCP send options to a list if the provided argument is non-empty.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_get_default_clientid
methods.description: Generates a default DHCP client ID based on the interface and global DUID if available.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCP client configuration for a specified interface, including options such as hostname, vendor ID, route options, and other DHCP parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Attempts to renew the DHCP lease for the specified interface by sending SIGUSR1 to udhcpc.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Terminates DHCP client process for the specified interface.
